description: Hitzeschutz Chemnitz (WMS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadtverwaltung Chemnitz. Publicly accessible drinking water fountains, flowering meadows, fountains and water games, refill stations, and cool parks and forests in the urban area of Chemnitz. Coverage: Stadtverwaltung Chemnitz. The portal shows the English title as "Heat protection Chemnitz (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadtverwaltung Chemnitz. Its keywords include Wasserspiel, Abkühlung, Nachfüllen, Wasser, Blühflächen, Kühl. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-08-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
